ingameEffects.label: Banquet of Pale Blood (Core Passive)
ingameEffects.description: ... While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, CRIT Rate increases by 30% and Gash Buildup Rate increases by 50%. Triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging or Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe increases DMG dealt for the remainder of the skill by 15%.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Claret's CRIT Rate is increased by 30%.

ingameEffects.label: Banquet of Pale Blood (Core Passive)
ingameEffects.description: ... While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, CRIT Rate increases by 30% and Gash Buildup Rate increases by 50%. Triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging or Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe increases DMG dealt for the remainder of the skill by 15%.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Claret's DMG from Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging or Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe is increased by 15%.

ingameEffects.label: Bloodline Legacy (Additional Ability)
ingameEffects.description: ... When Claret or another squad member triggers Maim, all Armorer Agents in the squad enter Remnant Edge. While in the Remnant Edge state, Laceration DMG is increased by 25%, lasting 40s. Triggering Remnant Edge again refreshes its duration.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Armorers' Laceration DMG is increased by 25% for 40s.

ingameEffects.label: Bloodstained Chronicle (Mindscape Cinema N°1)
ingameEffects.description: When Claret's attacks hit enemies and trigger Laceration, Gash Buildup Rate increases by 20%. The DMG Multiplier of Maim triggered by Claret increases to 130% of its original value.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This Mindscape Cinema will be available once Armorer's Maim DMG Calculator is finished.

ingameEffects.label: Crown of Inherited Flame (Mindscape Cinema N°2)
ingameEffects.description: The maximum duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 2s. While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, attacks ignore 18% of the target's Electric RES.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Claret's DMG ignores 18% of the target's Electric RES.

ingameEffects.label: Crimson Moon Wanderer (Mindscape Cinema N°4)
ingameEffects.description: During the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging, the time by which the consecutive slashes can be extended is increased. DMG dealt by Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging's 3rd hit, Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact, and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial increases by 20%.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Claret's DMG from Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging's 3rd hit, Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact, and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial is increased by 20%.

ingameEffects.label: Warm Night's Dream (Mindscape Cinema N°6)
ingameEffects.description: When the heavy attacks of Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial hit an enemy, Claret directly triggers 1 instance of single-target Maim without consuming Gash.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This Mindscape Cinema will be available once Armorer's Maim DMG Calculator is finished.

basicAttacks.name: Bloodforging Four Forms (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] to activate:

Performs up to four strikes forward, dealing Electric DMG.

basicAttacks.name: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] while in the /bCrimson Inscription//b state to activate:

Performs up to three slashes forward with the /bBlood Axe//b, dealing Electric DMG. When the second attack is launched, Claret leaps backward and throws the /bBlood Axe//b. A /bPerfect Dodge//b can be triggered during the retreat.

When the third attack is launched, Claret performs a series of slashes before leaping up and performing a downward smash. During the repeated slashes, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. Repeatedly press or hold [BASIC] to extend the duration of the repeated slashes. Stop pressing or release [BASIC] to make Claret immediately leap up and perform a downward smash. A /bPerfect Dodge//b can be triggered while leaping.

After successfully triggering a /bPerfect Dodge//b, press or hold [BASIC] to follow up with the 3rd hit of /bBasic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging//b. /bCrimson Inscription//b will not end during this skill.

basicAttacks.name: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
While in the /bCrimson Inscription//b state, after launching /bSpecial Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron//b or /bSpecial Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault//b to trigger /bMaim//b, press or hold [BASIC] to activate:

Spins and leaps into the air with the /bBlood Axe//b, then slams down and slashes the target enemy, dealing Electric DMG. A /bPerfect Dodge//b can be triggered while leaping. After using the skill, press or hold [BASIC] to chain into the 3rd hit of /bBasic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging//b. /bCrimson Inscription//b will not end during this skill.

dashAttacks.name: Tempering (Dash Attack)
dashAttacks.description:
While not in the /bCrimson Inscription//b state, press [BASIC] during a /bDodge//b to activate:

Performs a forward hammer strike, dealing Electric DMG.

dodgeCounters.name: Returning Edge (Dodge Counter)
dodgeCounters.description:
Press [BASIC] during a /bPerfect Dodge//b to activate:

Uses the hammer handle to deliver a powerful forward counterattack, dealing Electric DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounters.name: Bloodbloom Oath - Returning Edge (Dodge Counter)
dodgeCounters.description:
Press [BASIC] during a /bPerfect Dodge//b to activate:

Delivers a powerful forward counterattack with the /bBlood Axe//b, dealing Electric DMG. /bCrimson Inscription//b will not end during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssists.name: Return of the Dire Moon (Quick Assist)
quickAssists.description:
When the active character is launched, press [ASSIST] to activate:

Deals Electric DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssists.name: Bloodbloom Oath - Return of the Dire Moon (Quick Assist)
quickAssists.description:
When the active character is launched, press [ASSIST] to activate:

Deals Electric DMG. /bCrimson Inscription//b will not end during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: Bloodbloom Oath - Pureforged Edge (Assist Follow-Up)
assistFollowup.description:
Press [BASIC] after a /bDefensive Assist//b to activate:

Deals massive Electric DMG. /bCrimson Inscription//b will not end during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: Give Not an Inch of Steel (Counter Assist)
assistFollowup.description:
When Claret or the on-field character is about to be hit by certain enemies' /bControl Skills//b, press [ASSIST] to activate:

Engages the enemy in a power struggle. Win the struggle to neutralize the enemy's /bControl Skill//b and deal Electric DMG. /bCrimson Inscription//b's duration does not decrease during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: Bloodbloom Oath - Hammer Into Shape (Assist Follow-Up)
assistFollowup.description:
After using a /bCounter Assist//b, press [BASIC] to activate:

Deals massive Electric DMG. When the heavy attack hits an enemy, it adds one stack of /bGash//b to the target. /bCrimson Inscription//b's duration does not decrease during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

specialAttacks.name: Porcelume's First Call (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
Press [SPECIAL] to activate:

Launches two bludgeoning attacks forward, dealing Electric DMG. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

specialAttacks.name: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
While in the /bCrimson Inscription//b state, press [SPECIAL] or [EX] to activate:

Performs a powerful upward slash forward, then follows up with a horizontal slash, dealing Electric DMG. If the horizontal slash hits an enemy inflicted with /bGash//b, triggers /bMaim//b on the target, dealing additional AoE Electric DMG. /bCrimson Inscription//b will not end during this skill. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill. After successfully inflicting /bMaim//b, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

specialAttacks.name: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
While in the /bCrimson Inscription//b state and during the upward slash of /bSpecial Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron//b, keep holding [SPECIAL] or [EX] to activate:

PPerforms three consecutive horizontal slashes forward, dealing massive Electric DMG. Each horizontal slash that hits an enemy inflicted with /bGash//b triggers /bMaim//b on the target, dealing additional AoE Electric DMG.

Up to 3 consecutive instances of /bMaim//b can be triggered during this skill, with the third having a higher Interrupt Level. /bCrimson Inscription//b will not end during this skill. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while using this skill. After successfully inflicting /bMaim//b, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

exSkills.name: Bloodbloom Oath - Secret Forging Techniques (EX Special Attack)
exSkills.description:
With enough /bSharpness//b, and while Claret is not in the /bCrimson Inscription//b state, press [EX] to activate:

PTransforms the forging hammer into the /bBlood Axe//b to slash the target enemy, dealing Electric DMG. After using this skill, Claret enters the /bCrimson Inscription//b state for 16s. While off-field, its duration no longer decreases.

When Claret's attacks hit an enemy, if the enemy is defeated within 0.5s and /bCrimson Inscription//b's remaining duration is not 0, the duration of /bCrimson Inscription//b is extended by 3s. This effect can trigger once every 3s.

During this skill, keep holding [EX] to skip the slash and quickly chain into the alternate /bSpecial Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron//b and /bSpecial Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault//b. After using this skill, press or hold [BASIC] to chain into the 3rd hit of /bBasic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging//b. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chainAttacks.name: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact (Chain Attack)
chainAttacks.description:
When a /bChain Attack//b is triggered, select the character to activate:

Launches a series of slashes against enemies ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG. /bCrimson Inscription//b's duration does not decrease, and the state does not end during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial (Ultimate)
ultimate.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [ULTIMATE] to activate:

Launches a series of slashes against enemies ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG. /bCrimson Inscription//b's duration does not decrease, and the state does not end during this skill. Upon activating this skill, gain 10 /bSharpness//b. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
